<!-- durable-reviewer:review -->

This pull request was not reviewed automatically because its author does not have write access to this repository. A maintainer with write access can start a review by commenting `clanky review` (or `clanker review` or `@clanky-the-clanker review`), optionally followed by instructions (e.g. `clanky review focus on the retry logic`).
Closing as superseded: main already covers this change, so this PR is no longer needed. Thanks for the review and for your time.
